sections.title: 1. Payment & Booking Fees
paragraphs: Where facility usage or booking fees apply, all payments made through the app must be completed using designated and approved payment gateways. If a facility is offered free of charge, monetary refunds will not apply, but slot cancellation rules still govern user account standing.

sections.title: 2. User-Initiated Cancellations
paragraphs: Refund or credit eligibility depends on when the booking is cancelled relative to the scheduled slot start time.

rows: 24 Hours or more prior to slot start time
Less than 24 Hours prior to slot start time

sections.title: 3. Facility-Initiated Cancellations
paragraphs: If a booking is canceled by the institution or app administration due to unforeseen circumstances (such as emergency facility repairs, severe weather conditions, or mandatory official campus events):
list: A 100% refund or immediate slot reschedule option will be provided automatically to the affected user.

sections.title: 4. Refund Processing Time
paragraphs: Approved monetary refunds will be processed within **7 to 10 business days** back to the original method of payment used during booking.
Internal app credits (if applicable) will be reflected immediately in your app profile.
